string-array.name: whats_new_1_4_29
string-array.item: A simpler Settings screen: four short groups, with everything you set once in Preferences and backup and restore in one place
Smoother, redesigned charts in Analysis and Categories
The receipt scanner now gets ready by itself when Google Play services needs to download it
A new searchable open source licences screen, and crash fixes

string-array.name: whats_new_1_4_28
string-array.item: Share a UPI payment message or screenshot to Expense Manager and it\'s filled in for you: amount, payee, date and category
Scan a shop receipt with your camera from the Add screen. The account and category are suggested from the receipt and your past entries
Screenshots are read on your phone, nothing is uploaded, and the image is saved with the transaction
A reminder on Home when daily reminders are off, so you can turn them back on in one tap

string-array.name: whats_new_1_4_26
string-array.item: Plan ahead: set rent, bills or salary to repeat from a future date, and see what\'s coming in the new Upcoming card on Home
A heads-up the evening before a weekly, monthly or yearly payment is added
One-tap repeats: your frequent entries appear as chips when you add a transaction
Search all your transactions, with totals for what matches
Reorder the Home screen and choose which tab the app opens on
A simpler Get started card, and many small fixes

resources.string: A gentle nudge each evening helps you keep your spending up to date.
